summary: Verified Airtable-backed blog flow end-to-end: public blog list, single post + Lead Magnet widget, lead magnet submission, and admin auth + list + draft creation. All 4 acceptance criteria pass. Backend endpoints healthy, frontend renders correctly, integration between frontend/backend/Airtable/MongoDB works.
passed: GET /api/blog returns 2 posts from Airtable (personalized-outreach, compounding-growth-flywheel)
POST /api/blog/lead-magnet with {email, slug} returns {status: 'ok'} (stores in MongoDB lead_magnet_signups + Airtable)
GET /api/admin/blog with X-Admin-Token '<redacted>' returns 200 with 2 posts
Frontend /blog page renders featured post + card (verified via UI screenshot)
Lead magnet form submit shows success message 'Playbook sent! Check your inbox shortly.'
Admin login at /admin/blog with <redacted> authenticates and lists both existing posts
Admin can create a new DRAFT post via New Post form; new row appears in admin list with 'Post created' toast
notes: Blog list uses data-testid='blog-featured' (not slug-suffixed) for the hero card and 'blog-post-{slug}' for grid cards; consumers of AdminBlogPage use 'admin-post-row-{slug}'. All flows exercised via public preview URL.
